plugins.name: agents
plugins.description: Persistent AI collaboration partners in Claude Code — named agents with calibrated autonomy, memory, action trackers, and playbooks. Skills: /agents:help (guide), /agents:start (run an agent), /agents:list, /agents:status (org board), /agents:next (next best action), /agents:doctor (health review), /agents:schedule (unattended tasks), /agents:ask (peer request via Herdr), /agents:new (build one), /agents:init (set up a workspace).
